 Ajay Devgn's Drishyam The Conclusion, directed by Abhishek Pathak, is heading to close its entire box office run around Rs. 573 crore gross globally. 
 Written by

 Drishyam The Conclusion Final Worldwide Box Office Collections: Ajay Devgn's thriller set to wrap theatrical run to Rs 573 crore globally 
 Drishyam: The Conclusion, starring Ajay Devgn in the lead role, has almost exhausted its theatrical run at the box office. The movie is heading to close its WEEK 5 around Rs. 6 crore, which will take its theatrical cume to Rs. 368.50 crore nett at the Indian box office. 
 Backed by Panorama Studios, the movie will face Ramayana from tomorrow onwards, which means that the movie will retain only a handful of screens for its further run. That said, it is expected to wind up its entire theatrical run under Rs. 370 crore nett (Rs. 444 crore gross), domestically. 
 The Box Office Collections for Drishyam: The Conclusion in India are as follows:

 Total 
 Rs. 368.50 cr.
 (Rs. 370 cr. final exp.) 
 Besides its commendable domestic run, the movie performed well overseas too. It fetched around USD 13.60 million (Rs. 129 crore) from the International markets. That said, the movie is heading to close its entire box office run at Rs. 574 crore gross globally. It not only emerged as a BLOCKBUSTER but also  became Ajay Devgn 's highest-grossing film . It also marks the end of the popular Drishyam franchise.
